subject: Bespoke bars and entertaining furniture
hook: The edges on a bar take more knocks than almost any other furniture. Watch how we build for that.
ig:
The edges on a bar take more knocks than almost any other furniture. Watch how we build for that.

Bags, chairs, elbows and the occasional bottle all find the front edge of a bar. So when we make bar and drinks cabinets, the build is planned around a busy night rather than an empty showroom:

• Panels cut to suit the exact space, whether that is an alcove or under the stairs
• Thicker ABS edging on the edges that face the room, where knocks happen
• Hinge cups and shelf-pin rows drilled so doors hang level and bottle shelves can move
• Assembled and checked in our Hanley workshop, soft-close as standard
• Handles in antique gold or matt black to suit the room

It is still furniture, so coasters are a good idea. But the details that take the daily wear are built in from the start.

Planning something for entertaining? Comment BAR and we will send you the link.
fb:
Ever noticed how the front edge of a bar or drinks cabinet ends up chipped before anything else? It takes knocks from chairs, bags and the odd bottle.

When we build bar cabinets in our Hanley workshop, the edges that face the room get thicker ABS edging, doors are drilled and hung with soft-close hinges, and shelves are drilled for pins so they can move as your collection changes. The finishing touch is the handles, often antique gold for a bar.

If you fancy a proper spot for drinks before the festive get-togethers, have a look at what we make:
